query: INSERT INTO privacy.update_email (id, contact_id, email, source, confirm_salt, stored_at) SELECT $1, c.id, $3, 'quote_page', $4, $5 FROM privacy.contact c WHERE c.id = $2 ON CONFLICT (contact_id) DO UPDATE SET id = EXCLUDED.id, email = EXCLUDED.email, confirm_salt = EXCLUDED.confirm_salt, stored_at = EXCLUDED.stored_at, confirmed_at = NULL, bounced_at = NULL
